task: Buy a medium t-shirt in blue and pay by card
headline: 5 of 5 users could not buy a medium t-shirt in blue and pay by card.
subline: Color and size selections provide no visible feedback and the Add to bag button produces no confirmation, so users cannot complete the purchase.

issues.title: Color selection buttons have no visible labels or selected state

quote.text: I'm unsure which color is blue and don't want to guess and make a mistake.

issues.why: All five users could not identify which swatch represented blue. The buttons are unlabeled and show no selection highlight, so users click repeatedly without confirmation. Diego gave up after six steps because he could not find the options quickly. Margaret quit at step 17 after failing to distinguish the blue dot.

fix.summary: Add visible labels and a clear selected state to each color swatch.
fix.before: Color swatches are unlabeled buttons with no visible selection indicator.
fix.after: .color-swatch { position: relative; } .color-swatch::after { content: attr(data-color); position: absolute; bottom: -1.5em; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); font-size: 0.75rem; white-space: nowrap; } .color-swatch[aria-pressed='true'] { outline: 3px solid #0066cc; outline-offset: 2px; }

issues.title: Add to bag button gives no feedback that the item was added

quote.text: Nothing I do here seems to work. I'm done.

issues.why: Three users clicked Add to bag multiple times (Aisha 4 times, Kofi 3 times, Sunita 3 times) because the UI did not change: no cart count update, no toast, no navigation. They interpreted the silence as failure and abandoned the task.

fix.summary: Show immediate confirmation and navigate toward checkout after adding an item.
fix.before: Clicking Add to bag leaves the user on the product page with no visible change.
fix.after: On click, increment the cart badge, show a toast "Added to bag - Medium / Blue", and reveal a persistent "View bag" button that links to the checkout page.

quote.text: Check if these are color selectors

issues.why: Expert audit flags elements 7, 12–16, and 18–23 as having no accessible name (WCAG 4.1.2). Screen readers announce only "button", so non-visual users cannot identify or operate the selectors.

fix.summary: Add aria-label to every color swatch and size button.

issues.title: Size buttons lack a visible selected state
issues.why: Users selected M but could not verify the choice was registered. The only cue is a subtle style change on M that several participants missed, leading to repeated Add to bag clicks.

fix.summary: Make the selected size button unmistakable.
fix.before: Size buttons (XS–XXL) show only a faint style difference when active.

issues.title: Size guide button is covered and cannot be opened
issues.why: Aisha clicked the Size guide link on S2 (element 17) but on S3 the corresponding button (element 26) is overlapped by another element, so the guide cannot be opened. Margaret also scrolled repeatedly looking for size information.

fix.summary: Ensure the Size guide button is not obscured.
fix.before: Element 26 is covered by a sibling container, making it unclickable.

issues.title: Footer links point to placeholder anchors

quote.text: Going back to homepage to start over finding tees.

issues.why: Shipping, Returns, Size guide, and Contact links in the footer all use href="#". Margaret clicked Tees repeatedly and eventually went back to the homepage because the expected help pages were dead ends.

fix.summary: Replace placeholder footer links with real URLs or remove them until implemented.
fix.before: Footer links for Shipping, Returns, Size guide, and Contact point to '#'.
fix.after: Link each footer item to its dedicated policy page (e.g., /shipping, /returns, /size-guide, /contact) or hide the link until the page exists.

expert.finding: The page is titled checkout but displays a product homepage with no cart, checkout form, or payment fields, so users cannot buy a medium blue t-shirt or pay by card.
expert.suggestion: Replace the homepage content with the actual checkout page containing cart summary, size/color selection, and card payment form.

expert.finding: The color selection buttons (IDs 7, 8, 9) have no visible labels, so the user cannot tell which option is blue.
expert.suggestion: Add visible color names or swatches to the color selection buttons.

expert.finding: The blue t-shirt image has a row of five color swatches with no visible selection state, so users cannot confirm they have chosen blue before adding to cart.
expert.suggestion: Add a clear visual indicator (border or highlight) to the selected blue swatch and label it 'Blue'.

expert.finding: The color swatches (elements 12-16) are unlabeled buttons with no visible indication of which color is selected, so a user cannot confirm they have chosen blue.
expert.suggestion: Add visible labels or a clear selected state (such as a border or highlight) to the blue color swatch (element 15).

expert.finding: The size buttons (elements 18-23) have no visible selected state, so the user cannot confirm they have selected Medium before adding to bag.
expert.suggestion: Add a clear visual indicator (such as a border or background change) to the selected size button M (element 20).

expert.finding: The Size guide button (ID 26) is covered by another element and cannot be clicked.
expert.suggestion: Reposition the overlapping element so the Size guide button is fully accessible.

expert.finding: A control has no accessible name, so screen readers announce just "button".
expert.suggestion: Give icon-only buttons an aria-label (e.g. aria-label="Close") or visible text.

expert.finding: Three top-right buttons (ids 7, 8, 9) show only icons with no visible labels, forcing users to guess their function.

expert.finding: Footer links Shipping, Returns, Size guide, and Contact all point to '#' instead of real pages, breaking expected navigation.
expert.suggestion: Update the href attributes to point to the actual shipping, returns, size guide, and contact pages.

expert.finding: The XXL size button (element 23) is disabled with no explanation, which may confuse users about whether it is out of stock or unavailable for this product.
expert.suggestion: Add a tooltip or inline text explaining why XXL is disabled, or remove it if it is not available for this item.

expert.finding: The 'Size guide' link (element 17) and the 'Size guide' button (element 26) duplicate the same destination using different element types, creating inconsistent navigation patterns.
expert.suggestion: Use a single consistent element type for the Size guide, such as keeping only the link (element 17) and removing the duplicate button (element 26).

expert.finding: The size buttons (IDs 18-23) use only letters with no indication of which size is currently selected beyond a subtle style on M.
expert.suggestion: Add a clear selected state (e.g., border or background highlight) to the active size button.

expert.finding: The Shipping & returns accordion (ID 27) uses a plus icon that does not change to indicate expanded state.
expert.suggestion: Toggle the icon to a minus when the section is expanded to match standard accordion behavior.
